parts.label: a
parts.technique: Solving simultaneous regression equations for point of intersection (mean point)
parts.reason: S2.2 explicitly excludes calculations involving regression lines; this part performs calculations directly with the given regression line equations.

parts.label: b
parts.technique: Calculating Sxy from regression line and Σxy
parts.reason: This calculation is used to build the correlation coefficient/regression apparatus, both of which are explicitly excluded (S2.2 regression line calculations excluded; S5.1 formula-based correlation coefficient calculation excluded); it depends on the excluded part (a) result too.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Calculating product moment correlation coefficient using the formula
parts.reason: S5.1 explicitly excludes calculation of correlation coefficients using the formula (calculator-only value is permitted, but the mark scheme here requires the Sxx, Sxy, Syy formula method), and this also depends on excluded parts (a) and (b).
